# Literals and lexical rules.

=== integer
42
--- want
42

=== negative integer
-7
--- want
-7

=== float
3.14
--- want
3.14

=== exponent
1e3
--- want
1000

=== leading dot
.5
--- want
0.5

=== trailing dot
5.
--- want
5

=== true
#t
--- want
#t

=== false
#f
--- want
#f

=== string
"hello"
--- want
"hello"

=== empty string
""
--- want
""

=== string escapes
"a\tb\nc\r\"d\"\\e"
--- want
(string "a\tb\nc\r\"d\"\\e")

=== string escapes all
"\0\a\b\f\v"
--- want
"\0\a\b\f\v"

=== utf8 passes through
"héllo wörld ✓"
--- want
"héllo wörld ✓"

=== empty list
(list)
--- want
(list)

=== list of mixed kinds
(list 1 "a" #t)
--- want
(list 1 "a" #t)

=== nested list
(list (list) (list 1 (list 2)))
--- want
(list (list) (list 1 (list 2)))

=== empty tuple
(tuple)
--- want
(tuple)

=== tuple
(tuple 1 2)
--- want
(tuple 1 2)

=== values is tuple
(values 1 2)
--- want
(tuple 1 2)

=== line comment
(+ 1 2) ; a comment
--- want
3

=== comment lines between expressions
;; first
(set a 1)
;; second
(+ a 1)
--- want
2

=== bom is stripped
﻿(+ 1 2)
--- want
3

=== symbol with colon
given field:for = 3
(* field:for 2)
--- want
6

=== bool literal must be exact
#true
--- error

=== bool literal needs a boundary
#t#f
--- error

=== unsupported escape
"\q"
--- error

=== unterminated string
"abc
--- error

=== unterminated list
(list 1
--- error

=== stray close paren
)
--- error

=== only a comment is an empty script
; nothing here
--- error

=== plus sign literal
+5
--- want
5

=== plus sign with leading dot
+.5
--- want
0.5

=== exponent with sign
1e-2
--- want
0.01

=== uppercase exponent
2E3
--- want
2000

=== inf is a symbol
inf
--- error

=== negative inf is a symbol
-inf
--- error

=== nan is a symbol
nan
--- error

=== Infinity is a symbol
Infinity
--- error

=== underscore is not a digit separator
1_000
--- error

=== hex literal is a symbol
0x10
--- error

=== exponent without digits is a symbol
1e
--- error

=== dot alone is a symbol
.
--- error

=== trailing garbage makes a symbol
12abc
--- error
